name: Suki no Katachi
source:
Two years ago protagonist's father died suddenly while working in United States leaving lots of money and house that is too huge to live alone. But one day father's American wife comes to Japan with her daughter to live together in this house! What should he do?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两年前，主人公的父亲在美国工作时突然去世，留下了大量的金钱和太大的房子，无法独自居住。但有一天，父亲的美国妻子带着女儿来到日本，一起住在这所房子里！他该怎么办？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
